description: Heal guard: check that changed tests were not made to pass by checking less. Compares spec files with a git ref (default HEAD = uncommitted changes) or one proposed file (file + after). BLOCK on deleted assertions, skipped/removed tests or .only; WARN on weaker matchers, waitForTimeout, force: true, swallowed errors, raised timeouts or retries. Run it after any AI fix, before committing.

after.description: With file: the fix's full new file content, checked before it is written

base.description: Git ref to compare with: 'HEAD' (default: uncommitted changes), 'origin/main' (the whole branch)

file.description: With after: the spec file a fix would change

files.description: Only these files (default: every changed spec file and playwright config)

name: check-test-change

fix.description: the replacement line, when the fix is mechanical

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Check a test fix (heal guard)
